import { Component, OnInit } from '@angular/core'; import { AdminService, Korisnik } from './admin.service'; import { Router, RouterModule } from '@angular/router'; @Component({ selector: 'app-admin', templateUrl: './admin.component.html', styleUrls: ['./admin.component.css'] }) export class AdminComponent implements OnInit { users: Korisnik[] = []; errorMessage: string | null = null; constructor(private adminService: AdminService, private router: Router) { } ngOnInit(): void { this.loadUsers(); } loadUsers(): void { this.adminService.getUsers().subscribe({ next: (users) => { this.users = users; }, error: (err) => { console.error('Failed to load users:', err); } }); } editUser(userId: number): void { this.router.navigate([`/admin/edit-user/${userId}`]); } deleteUser(userId: number): void { if (confirm('Are you sure you want to delete this user?')) { this.adminService.deleteUser(userId).subscribe({ next: () => { this.loadUsers(); }, error: (err) => { console.error('Failed to delete user:', err); } }); } } }
